title: Tax-free savings newsletter 22
text:
This newsletter is published by HMRC to update stakeholders on the latest news for Individual Savings Account ( ISA ) managers and Child Trust Fund providers.

 Tax-free savings newsletter 22 has articles on:

 • the reform of ISA rules

 • a first-time buyer ISA consultation

 • the future of Help to Save
changeNote: The 'Tax-free savings newsletter 22 — June 2026' has been updated to explain that draft legislation has now been published for technical consultation.
